nodes.label: SEED-01..30 synthetic Jira ticket corpus
nodes.rationale: Validates technical function (indexing keeps provenance, hybrid search ranks correctly, matching distinguishes reformulation from shared vocabulary, rights filter applies before model exposure) — it does not measure real-corpus banking performance, and no similarity threshold should be frozen on this data alone.

nodes.label: semantic_pairs_gold.csv
nodes.rationale: 22 pairs labeled duplicate/related/unrelated; absent pairs are not implicitly unrelated — counting them as negatives would bias precision.

nodes.label: retrieval_queries_gold.csv (piege_attendu)
nodes.rationale: piege_attendu names tickets that share vocabulary with a query without answering it — a search ranking them ahead of the expected tickets is doing keyword matching, not semantic search.
